milestone_summary.note: No degradation-class compromises (test weakening / error swallowing / type relaxation) were made or continued past in this batch. Both independent verifiers ran a forbidden-degradation scan on the full sprint diffs and reported 'clean'. Every review-found critical/high bug was FIXED (not conceded). The entries below are transparency items about verification COVERAGE, not degradations — recorded so the milestone review sees exactly what ran where (priority_rule 0).

compromises.rationale: Heavy real-machine tests (real systemd-run/setsid survival, parallel-instance isolation, real-claude MCP-deadline spike) are env-gated behind PALMUX_SURVIVAL_SMOKE=1 / PALMUX_SPIKE_S862203_1=1, matching the project's existing PALMUX_REALINCUS_SMOKE convention. They caused CPU-contention flakes (tripping claudeagent's pre-existing 2s-timeout tests) + process churn under the default parallel `go test`. They are NOT in the default `make test` gate.
compromises.diff_summary: added requireSurvivalSmoke(t) / spike env gate to the heavy tests; fast fake-injected unit logic stays in the default gate
compromises.recommended_action: These tests WERE executed explicitly during verify with the flags and all PASS (evidence: verify-survival-smoke.log, spike-S862203-1-1.json). If CI should run them, add a gated CI job. Verifiers judged the gating 'legitimate opt-in smoke', not hidden failures.

compromises.rationale: AC-S3f2658-4-1/4-2 real-incus smoke was executed x2 during Story 4 (documented PASS in e2e-S3f2658-4.json: pids unchanged across restart, reaped after SHUTDOWN, pre-existing containers byte-identical) but was NOT re-run during the verify phase, to avoid churning the dev box's incus (known degradation-under-churn risk) which also hosts the live host palmux2's containers.
compromises.diff_summary: n/a — coverage decision, not a code change
compromises.recommended_action: AC was genuinely executed with evidence during the story; re-run manually on a fresh incus box if independent re-confirmation is wanted.
